text:
Alex Chen: Hey @deal-desk — quick question: POC for Acme (ACME-519) needs a 60% first-year commit + 6-month Dedicated trial. What's the fastest approval path? Need to close EOD Fri.
Sara Patel: For commits >50% we need Deal Desk approval + Legal signoff. Fill Deal_Type__c = 'Commitment' and attach SOW template v3.
Deepak Rao: Also set Approval_TTL__c to 72h. If urgent mark Escalation_Flag__c = 'sales_urgent' and ping #deal-desk.
Alex Chen: Which CPQ checkbox maps to 'special_terms_poc'? Can't find it.
Emily Nguyen: It's "POC_Special_Terms__c" in CPQ. If true, auto-assign to Jamal for security review.
Jamal Ortiz: I'll take security review. Need the redlined NDA + list of data flows. If sensitive, we require Private deployment addendum.
Alex Chen: Can we get a pre-auth waiver to avoid waiting on Commitments approval for POC infra? Customer won't sign before trial.
Sara Patel: We have a pre-auth flow: submit 'preauth_request' (select 'POC Temporary Waiver') and attach a short business case (2-3 bullets). Deal Desk aims 24h SLA for preauth during business days.
Deepak Rao: Note: preauth doesn't change billing terms, just temporary access. Any commit outside rate card still needs post-POC contract.
Emily Nguyen: Template: attach 'preauth_poc_waiver.docx' from SF Files and set Routing_Group__c = 'EMEA_Sales' if EMEA.
Alex Chen: Pinged Dealbot to create request.
Dealbot: /deal-desk create preauth_request --deal ACME-519 --reason 'POC needs Dedicated GPU access' --attach preauth_poc_waiver.docx
Dealbot: Request 98321 created and routed to Deal Desk (priority: high). Expected SLA: 24h.
Jamal Ortiz: I'll review security by tomorrow noon. @LegalBot please flag NDA anomalies.
LegalBot: Noted. Will review NDA redlines within 48h, escalate if CISO signoff required.
Sara Patel: Quick FYI: For SFDC report purposes, ensure 'Pricing_Override__c' has the dollar amount and 'Override_Reason__c' is filled — otherwise CPQ blocks.
Alex Chen: Thanks all — will attach NDA + data flow diagram and set POC_Special_Terms__c = true. Will update once Deal Desk responds. :thumbsup:
